initial_requirements: Construction Junction needs a categorized inventory management system for staff who receive, organize, and sell donated materials. Users should be able to navigate departments and item categories, view individual inventory records, and add or update appropriate stock and unique items. The system must keep operational inventory information aligned with the organization's point-of-sale activities while supporting different staff responsibilities.
finish_message: Hashimoto interview completed (turn limit or slot fill rate reached).

messages.content: What are the primary business goals this inventory management system needs to achieve for Construction Junction, and how will you know it is successful?

The main goal is to help staff keep donated materials organized, accurate, and easy to find so we can receive, store, and sell items more efficiently. It also needs to keep inventory records aligned with what’s actually available for sale, so the point-of-sale side and the warehouse side match up better.
We’ll know it’s successful if staff can locate items faster, inventory counts are more accurate, and we have fewer mistakes between what’s on the shelf and what shows up in the system. It would also be a good sign if different staff roles can do their jobs without confusion and the system cuts down on manual tracking.
